sources.title: Influence of Dislocations in Thomson's Problem
sources.authors: A. Perez-Garrido, M. J. W. Dodgson, M. A. Moore
sources.derived_fact: Five-seven dislocation pairs can screen the unavoidable twelve fivefold disclinations; older Coulomb estimates put favorable additional dislocations at order 10^3 particles, and the landscape has exponentially many metastable states.

sources.title: Crystalline Order on a Sphere and the Generalized Thomson Problem
sources.authors: M. Bowick, A. Cacciuto, D. R. Nelson, A. Travesset
sources.derived_fact: Defects are represented by fivefold (+1) and sevenfold (-1) sites; dislocations and finite grain boundaries are built from these elementary disclinations.

sources.title: Grain Boundary Scars and Spherical Crystallography
sources.derived_fact: Spherical crystals can carry freely terminating alternating five-seven scars; observed onset is associated with a sufficiently large radius-to-spacing ratio.

sources.title: Interstitial fractionalization and spherical crystallography
sources.authors: M. J. Bowick, D. R. Nelson, H. Shin
sources.derived_fact: A minimal mini-scar is 5-7-5; dislocations glide parallel to their Burgers vectors toward fivefold disclinations, and thermal noise may be needed to cross the Peierls barrier.

operator_derivation.graph_rule: Flip the edge opposite an existing degree-5 vertex in an adjacent triangle. The old edge endpoints lose one degree, while the two opposite vertices gain one degree, changing the local defect inventory from one 5 to two 5s plus one 7 (a 5-7-5 charge pattern).
Apply a neighboring legal 2-2 flip that preserves the global 13x5/1x7 degree histogram; this transports the bound 5-7 defect without changing its net charge. One- and two-step paths are retained.
Apply a second local legal flip to a mini-scar and retain only degree-5/6/7 triangulations with 14x5/2x7, giving a two-dislocation extension.

Flip an edge whose four participating vertices are all degree 6. The update creates two degree-5 and two degree-7 sites, a neutral 5-7-7-5 defect quartet; neighboring histogram-preserving flips glide the dipole.

inference_limits: The literature motivates defect families and expected onset scales; it does not certify the discrete edge-flip implementation or global optimality.
